About TP Building Construction

Architecture, engineered with intent

TP Building Construction (Pty) Ltd is a Polokwane-based building practice specialising in distinguished double-storey and single-storey residences. We conceive, document, construct and finish each home as a single, resolved composition.

Our method joins architectural discipline with site-level rigour: considered massing, honest materials, exact detailing and a team accountable from the first sketch to the final key.
